reason: Accepted claims describe a warrior/healing and solar goddess, Eye of Ra, plague, vengeance and restored solar glory, but neither statements nor full quotes document lion-head, sun-disk headdress or any bodily iconography. The c08 full quote supports diminished/restored sun; a sun-only scene would leave the goddess absent and cannot reliably pass Sangar as an unmistakable active divine manifestation. Adding animal head, literal eye, destruction by heat or humanlike portrait would invent distinguishing form or power. Declined under GAMBAR 6.5; no image generation calls were made for Sekhmet.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: No render attempted: accepted claim statements and full quotes reviewed, physical iconography is insufficient. No outside source or conventional iconography imported.
